[package.metadata.android]
package = "com.wavelet.music"
apk_name = "Wavelet"
build_targets = ["aarch64-linux-android"]

[package.metadata.android.sdk]
min_sdk_version = 26
target_sdk_version = 34

[package.metadata.android.application]
label = "Wavelet"
theme = "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.NoActionBar"

[package.metadata.android.application.activity]
config_changes = "orientation|keyboardHidden|keyboard|screenSize|screenLayout|smallestScreenSize|uiMode"
launch_mode = "singleTop"

# Lets the app find songs in the phone's Music folder.
[[package.metadata.android.uses_permission]]
name = "android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
max_sdk_version = 32

[[package.metadata.android.uses_permission]]
name = "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO"

[[package.metadata.android.uses_permission]]
name = "android.permission.WAKE_LOCK"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
strip = true

# Builds the Android app (Wavelet.apk) for 64-bit ARM phones.
# Uses the Android SDK/NDK and cargo-apk unpacked into target\android-tools.
# Short (8.3) paths are used because the Android tools break on folder names with spaces.

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$fso = New-Object -ComObject Scripting.FileSystemObject
$app = $fso.GetFolder($PSScriptRoot).ShortPath
$tools = "$app\target\android-tools"

$jdk = Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium" -Directory -Filter "jdk-17*" | Select-Object -First 1
if ($jdk) { $env:JAVA_HOME = $fso.GetFolder($jdk.FullName).ShortPath }
$env:ANDROID_HOME = "$tools\sdk"
$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = "$tools\sdk"
$env:ANDROID_NDK_ROOT = "$tools\android-ndk-r26d"
$env:ANDROID_NDK_HOME = $env:ANDROID_NDK_ROOT
$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR = "$app\target\android-build"
$env:PATH = "$tools\cargo\bin;$env:PATH"

rustup target add aarch64-linux-android | Out-Null
Push-Location "$app\android"
try {
    cargo apk build --release --lib
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Android build failed" }
} finally { Pop-Location }

$apk = Get-ChildItem "$app\target\android-build\release\apk" -Filter *.apk | Select-Object -First 1
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$app\dist" | Out-Null
Copy-Item $apk.FullName "$app\dist\Wavelet.apk" -Force
Write-Host "Android app ready: $PSScriptRoot\dist\Wavelet.apk"

params.text:
State: desktop app passes rebuild_check. Sign-in removed: app opens straight into a local profile (AccountStore::profile(), default name "Listener"; old accounts.json still loads). Profile page = plan + edit name only. Phone layout (window width < 700): bottom tabs (Home/Search/Library/Profile), mini player, full now-playing card on Queue screen, stacked headers, tap-to-play rows. Test with WAVELET_SHOT_SIZE=412x880 WAVELET_SHOT_VIEW=home|playlist|queue|account.
Crate is now lib (src/lib.rs) + bin (src/main.rs). Android wrapper crate in app/android (cdylib, android_main, own Cargo.lock with pins: jobserver 0.1.32, cc 1.2.16 plus the desktop pins). Build Android with `powershell -File app/build-android.ps1` -> app/dist/Wavelet.apk (arm64, minSdk 26, signed with app/android/wavelet-release.keystore, password wavelet-local). Tools live in app/target/android-tools (SDK, NDK r26d, cargo-apk); the script uses 8.3 short paths because Android tools break on spaces. `cargo clean` deletes the tools.
Traps: never plain `cargo update` (brings raw-dylib crates; windows-gnu here has no working dlltool). Screenshot now waits while the window is minimised (egui_glow panicked on 0-size reads).
Open: APK untested on a real device; no runtime permission prompt for reading phone music (Android 13+ needs it granted in Settings); streaming catalog still needs the person.
